contract: v8 INPUT-TIMING arm: PREREGISTRATION v3, frozen and committed before any v8 smoke, fit or held-out run (v2 FAILED audit 1 / minor in audit 2 on the G3/G5 reconciliation; nothing had run).
hypothesis: The v7 F1 and the upstream diagnostic show excess latency at the R1-R6 -> LMC stage (model LMCs peak 14-22 ms AFTER R; Drosophila LMCs peak ~13 ms BEFORE R). If R1-R6 phototransduction timing and L1/L2 membrane timing are fitted to Drosophila R/LMC voltage timing, the UNCHANGED v6 leak40 medulla should predict the Behnia 2014 medulla filter timing.
label: EXPLORATORY; post hoc to v7 F1 and the upstream diagnostic. Inherits S1-A3 photoreceptor gain/adaptation (G, Ka, tau_a: FIT REJECTED in S1) and leak40 (hypothetical).

free_parameters.dead_time_note: v3 derivation from the ENGINE, not from 'onset >= D': v8_input.best_case_onsets(D) runs a minimal BrainV6 (one R1-R6 node -> L1, L2; weight -50; fastest free values tau_p0 0.5 ms, L tau_m 1 ms, no Ih; base R release; 2 s dark; the v8 flash) and gives R onset = D+1 ms (ring delay D + end-of-step read) and L onset = D+2 ms (1.8 ms graded-release delay) for D = 5..11; with weight -5 the L onset is D+3. G3 (all onsets <= 10 ms, |L-R| <= 3) is therefore feasible only for D <= 8 (D=9: L >= 11; D=10: R >= 11), and G5 (7-13 ms) requires D >= 7: grid {7, 8}. D = 8 is MARGINAL: it needs L to reach 10 % of its peak in its first sample after the synaptic delay.
free_parameters.fixed: R1-R6: G, Ka, tau_a_ms, n_stages=4, encoder_to_intensity (S1-A3) and the R1-R6 RELEASE (a synapse); L1/L2: e_leak (-40), Ih slope k (5 mV) and reversal (-30 mV); L3 entirely (no subtype data: Mansour's LMCs are unidentified, dominated by L1/L2; disclosed); every medulla type; every edge and base weight (graph 4b2f87cc...091d01)
free_parameters.identifiability: LMC targets (pooled subtype) are applied to BOTH L1 and L2; tau_m and Ih trade off; R gain/adaptation stays at the rejected S1-A3 values
free_parameters.graded_cells: v2 (audit 1 CANNOT-TELL): L1/L2 values are written only to GRADED cells of the type, exactly the set BrainV6 loads from a parameter file (in the S2 cutout every cell is graded, so the sets coincide; a test checks fit-applied == file-loaded on a mixed graded mask)

flash_LMC.dispersion: printed +-1.1 is neither s.d. (feasible 1.59-1.79) nor s.e.m. (0.71-0.80): NOT used; sigma = largest feasible s.d.

targets.window_rule: gate window = printed [min, max] widened by 1 ms (the model's 1 ms sampling resolution): R 23-30 ms, LMC 10-16 ms; every recorded cell, including the 15.0 ms LMC, lies inside
targets.sources: flash_*: Mansour et al. 2026 Supp. Fig. 1b; kernel_tp and dead time: Juusola & Hardie 2001 (V8_data_pin_v2.json)

protocols.cutout: the frozen S2 7-column cutout (scripts/v6/fit_s2.build_cutout); readout = a central-column R1-R6 node, the central L1 and L2
protocols.flash_level_assumption: encoder 330 = 3.3 x BG0 = JH2001's brightest impulse (~10,000 effective photons per ms); Mansour's 'bright' flash intensity is not given in photons; ASSUMPTION
protocols.measurement: flash: deflection from the pre-flash value; onset = first |dV| >= 10 % of peak; time to peak = argmax |dV|. ALL model times include +1 ms (v2, audit 1 item 5c): V is read at the END of each 1 ms step, so sample k is time k+1 ms. The held-out peaks get the same +1 ms.
protocols.jh2001_kernel: v2 (audit 1 item 2): like JH2001, the R1-R6 LINEAR KERNEL from Gaussian contrast noise (s.d. 0.32, first-order 150 Hz low-pass, seed 8002, 4 s) about each background after a 3 s settle; FFT estimator (1 s zero-padded snippets every 100 ms, eps 1 %); time to peak of the kernel (v8_input.measure/kernel)
protocols.dead_time_comparison: the model's pure-delay PARAMETER D is compared with JH2001's phase-derived pure delay at BG0 (G5); the model's D is fixed across backgrounds, so JH2001's BG-4 D (~20 ms) is NOT a target (cannot be met by construction; disclosed)

bg_decidability.rule: v2 (audit 2 D2), PRE-WRITTEN: step 0 measures run 0's start values once. A background whose R kernel peak < 1e-3 mV per unit contrast per ms or whose R response s.d. < 0.01 mV is NOT EVALUABLE and is dropped from G4 and the objective for every run (labelled). If BG0 is not evaluable, or any flash time is non-finite, the WHOLE ARM is NOT EVALUABLE and no fit runs. During the fit, an evaluable background that falls below the floor in a run fails that run's G4.

objective: sum of squared standardised errors: flash R tp (sigma 2.4) and onset (1.5); flash L1, L2 tp (sigma 1.79) and onset (1.5); R kernel tp at each EVALUABLE background (sigma 20 %); +1e6 for a non-finite value or an unmeasurable evaluable background (v8_input.objective). The dead time is grid-fixed (gate G5 only).

optimiser.start_0: base values clipped to the bounds
optimiser.start_1: Latin hypercube in the transformed box (5 draws per D, same seed)
optimiser.selection: among COMPLETED runs whose own gates give TRAIN_PASS, the lowest objective; tie -> lowest run id (v8_input.outcome)
optimiser.completion: a run killed at the 2 h wall cap or crashed is not completed; fewer than 6 of 12 completed -> NOT EVALUABLE (never F1)
optimiser.resources: CPU only, CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1, <= 4 processes at a time, nice, taskset -c 0-3

compute_budget.per_eval: ~1.9 s (24.1 s simulated: 10.1 s flash + 2 x 7 s noise, at the v7-measured ~0.077 s per simulated s; EXTRAPOLATED, measured at step 0)
compute_budget.fit: 12 runs (2 D values x 6 starts) x 2000 evaluations x ~1.9 s = ~12.7 core-h; 3 waves of 4 = ~3.2 h wall; hard cap 2 h wall per run

training.G1: flash R1-R6 time to peak within the printed range +-1 ms: 23-30 ms
training.G2: flash L1 AND L2 time to peak within the printed range +-1 ms: 10-16 ms, AND earlier than R
training.G3: split in v3: G3_R = flash R onset within 4-10 ms (R STAGE); G3_L = L1 and L2 onsets within 4-10 ms AND |L - R| <= 3 ms (LMC STAGE)
training.G4: R kernel time to peak within 25 % of 40 ms (BG-4) and 20 ms (BG0) at each EVALUABLE background, AND faster at BG0 when both are evaluable
training.G5: the model's pure delay D within 30 % of JH2001's BG0 D (10 ms): 7-13 ms. NON-BINDING over the v3 grid {7, 8} (both satisfy it): G5 acts only through the grid construction (it excludes D <= 6); it is reported, and is not evidence about the R stage
training.R_STAGE: G1 and G3_R and G4 and G5
training.TRAIN_PASS: R_STAGE and LMC_STAGE on the run's own parameters (v8_input.train_gates)
training.G3_G5_reconciliation: v3: replaced. The engine bounds (free_parameters.dead_time_note) make G3 feasible only for D <= 8; G5 admits D >= 7; the grid is their intersection {7, 8}. v2's statement 'onset >= D, onset in [D, 10]' ignored the +1 ms read offset and the 1.8 ms release delay and was wrong.

heldout.protocol: frozen params_v8.json, medulla at v6 leak40 (NO medulla fitting), v7 v2 noise protocol and observation model (filter against u = c/2), Behnia digitised filters from the v7 pin Model peaks include the +1 ms sampling offset.
heldout.H1: model filter peak within 2 x text s.e.m. + 5 ms of the digitised peak for >= 3 of Mi1, Tm3, Tm1, Tm2
heldout.H2: Mi1 later than Tm3 AND Tm1 later than Tm2, each by >= 5 ms
heldout.descriptive_only: filter NRMSE and response s.d. vs Fig. 3a (the v7 amplitude gap is not expected to close: see synapse test)
heldout.label: independent data (other lab, cells, method) but NOT analyst-blind

outcomes.NOT_EVALUABLE: step 0 declares the arm not evaluable, OR fewer than 6 of 12 runs completed: no claim; stop
outcomes.F1_R: no completed run passes the R stage (G1, G3_R, G4, G5): the photoreceptor model (fixed n_stages, fixed D, rejected S1-A3 gain/adaptation) does not reproduce Drosophila R timing UNDER the flash-level (encoder 330), noise-contrast and single-D assumptions. The R->LMC transfer is NOT tested.
outcomes.F1_LMC: some completed run passes the R stage (G1, G3_R, G4, G5), but no run passes both stages: with the v6 release synapse fixed, L1/L2 tau and Ih cannot make the LMC peak before R with onsets within 4-10 ms and no synaptic delay beyond 3 ms. CONDITIONAL on the flash level, noise contrast, single fixed D and the S1-A3 assumptions; and on the engine's fixed 1.8 ms graded-release delay.
outcomes.F2_propagation: TRAIN_PASS but HELDOUT_PASS false: correct input timing does not make the unchanged medulla reproduce Behnia's timing; the remaining error is in the medulla/synapse model
outcomes.PASS: TRAIN_PASS and HELDOUT_PASS: exploratory; any S3 needs a separate owner go and addendum
outcomes.always_reported: all runs, both stage verdicts per run, all gates, the step-0 smoke, the synapse test

synapse_transfer_test.status: PREREGISTERED, DESCRIPTIVE (no gate on any arm, no fit); no non-motion paired L1-Mi1/Tm3 voltage measurement was found to fit to
synapse_transfer_test.run_on: params_v6_S2A_leak40.json now-or-later, and the frozen params_v8.json if TRAIN_PASS
synapse_transfer_test.measures: (a) steady-state L1/Mi1/Tm3 voltage at encoder 0-1000 and slope dMi1/dL1; (b) Behnia Fig. 2 protocol flash onset TRANSIENT peaks (signed); (c) disinhibition CEILING: L1 release gain set to 0 in memory from dark rest, SIGNED TRANSIENT peak within 1 s
synapse_transfer_test.reading: v2: (1) SIGN: ceiling <= 0 -> NOT APPLICABLE (silencing L1 does not depolarise the cell). (2) threshold = digitised Fig. 2 onset peak - 2 x its digitisation uncertainty (Mi1 28.4 mV, Tm3 23.1 mV), transient vs transient: below -> SUGGESTIVE (never 'structural': biological spread unknown) that L1 disinhibition alone cannot reach the measured ON amplitude; else REACHABLE. Replaces v1's arbitrary 15 mV.

smoke_pin.procedure: step 0 runs fit_v8.py --smoke, then a commit (noreply, no trailers) adds qualification/v8/V8_smoke_pin.json = {prereg_sha256: <this file>, smoke_v8_sha256: <sha256 of smoke_v8.json>, smoke_v8_copy: qualification/v8/smoke_v8.json} and the report copy, BEFORE any fit run. fit_v8.py refuses to fit unless that pin file exists in the checkout, names this prereg's sha256, and matches the --smoke-report bytes.
